notes.title: No Longer Home 60% off in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30365921/535ba117533518f4412d14edca03d628556d72e8.png

The annual Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale is now on - and to celebrate, No Longer Home is 60% off! 

➡️ Take me to the Publisher Sale ⬅️

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; Scrabdackle, Wander Stars and Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - read up on each of them below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif

 Wander Stars: Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
 Scrabdackle: As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
 Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo: A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.So get exploring and grab some great narrative games!

notes.title: No Longer Home: Art Stream and Chat With the Developers
notes.content:
LudoNarraCon is taking place May 5-9, and No Longer Home is participating.

Hana and Cel, the developers of No Longer Home, will be hosting an art stream and developer chat. They will chat about what it was like to release a game as well as compare and contrast their lives back in 2014 (when the game is set) to their lives now.

You can tune into the stream right here on our Steam page as the video will be on a loop so you can tune in anytime over the weekend. Come and join us for a relaxing, chill time!

If you’ve not played No Longer Home, you can download the demo and try it out during LudoNarracon, or purchase the full-game at a whopping 50% off.

Keep up to date on No Longer Home by following our Twitter and joining our Discord.

notes.title: No Longer Home: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
New

 Accessibility options appear on launch for all players after installing the update or if no config file is found.
 Added Screen Reader on Windows and MacOS. Windows requires you to download NVDA, a free screen reader. 
 Added Linear Navigation, an option to adjust the game to use simple keyboard/controller controls. Auto enabled when Screen Reader is active.
 Added Bigger Dialogue Text, an option to toggle between 32pt and 38pt font during dialog and dialog menus.
 Added Dyslexic Dialog Font, an option to toggle between Anonymous Pro and OpenDyslexic fonts. Only available when the current language is English.
 Added Selection Indicator, an option that adds a visual indicator to discern your selection. Auto disabled when Linear Navigation is active.
 Added Use System Cursor, an option to toggle between using NLH's pixel cursor and your system cursor.
 Added Fast Skip, skips dialog every 0.3 seconds as long as the button is held. Button is the Space or Enter key on keyboard and mouse and the Run button on controllers.

Changes

 Updated Xbox controller icons to be more in line with modern Xbox iconography.
 Increased height of dialog and dialog menus to accommodate the bigger dialogue text.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where pause menu items could not be selected with the mouse during the Bo’s dream sequence while the dialogue menu was hidden.
 Fixed instances where Among the Leaves’ dialogue was displayed at the bottom of the screen instead of the top.

Screen Reader Notes

 The screen reader's voice and volume cannot be changed within the game, instructions on how to change it below.
 Auto skip cannot be enabled when the screen reader is enabled due to limitation to detecting when the Screen Reader finishes speaking.
 Text prints all at once when screen reader is enabled, this is so the screen reader properly reads the text.
 NVDA users: We recommend you disable "Speak typed characters" under Keyboard in Settings.
 MacOS users: We have observed audio issues on MacBook speakers when dialogue starts and finishes, using headphones are recommended

How to adjust Screen Reader Volume and Voice

 NVDA: Right click NVDA in the system toolbar and navigate to Preferences > Settings > Speech. 
 MacOS: Open System Preferences and navigate to Accessibility > Spoken Content.
 
Linear Navigation Notes

 Minimal UI is auto enabled when Linear Navigation is enabled. Keyboard/Controller buttons for Auto Skip, Narrative Log, and Pause all still work.
 If Screen Reader is disabled Linear Navigation will skip the selection of labels since they have no interaction without the Screen Reader.
 While Linear Navigation is enabled, UI will be revealed automatically without needing to navigate the scene.

notes.title: No Longer Home: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30365921/aaf79ba7f3c392f8e9c26901c620a4d8a4aeef45.png

Hi all,

Version 1.1.0 of No Longer Home has been pushed live.

Thanks to everyone for your feedback and bug reports so far. As a quick reminder, please report any bugs you find in this thread.

Changelog:

 Enhanced Dialogue UI, adds auto text skip, narrative log, and pause buttons to the Dialogue UI. These changes can be disabled by selecting “Minimal UI” in the Visuals Options
 Auto text skip, allow text to auto progress without the need of clicking. Togglable via Tab on keyboard, the top most face button on controllers (Y on Xbox), or clicking the auto text skip button on the Enhanced Dialogue UI.
 Narrative Log can be accessed via controller now by the left face button (X on Xbox)
 Added option to skip playing Friary Road when no save data exists.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed incorrect camera position after the bathtub animation. (Link)
 Credits wouldn’t play at the end of the game in certain situations. (Link)
 Studio door would disappear when loading a save in the studio before interacting with the Unknown Geometry.
 Typo fixes for Ao’s Suitcase 2, Ao’s Sketchbook and Bo in Bed.
 Mop Bucket no longer appears outside if Bo knows Ao stole it back.

[previewyoutube=GLDoE0SVEYw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: No Longer Home (formally known as 29) Pricing Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30365921/e005bb2e3217a3e1361f2b2b1a8708fae008efa0.png

Hello!

It's been a little while since we've made an update on Steam. We've been intensely busy developing No Longer Home (formerly known as 29), after a successful Kickstarter campaign. We're really close to finishing the first chapter now and plan to release it this year. It's grown a lot since it's first inception and because of that we decide to make some changes. 

No Longer Home will now be a paid for game. We don't have a price to announce yet, but you can expect to to be around the $20 mark. It will consist of 3 chapters that we plan to release episodically, and the single payment will get you access to all of the chapters. We don't have a set release schedule yet, but we will keep you updated. 

Sorry if you were looking forward to playing it for free, it was a difficult decision for us to make as well. Considering the amount of time and effort we put into it, this was the most sensible thing for us to do. We do, however, have a prequel to No Longer Home called Friary Road which you can download here for free: https://humblegrove.itch.io/friary-road

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30365921/7f0421aab69c2a5e8c549790a999f4d4117827d4.png

notes.title: Kickstarter and new game Friary Road
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Remember we said in the previous post that we have some exciting news to share? We actually have TWO announcements to make!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30365921/c00b0c669f506df29b73daa994ab08ae88039461.png
No Longer Home will be coming to Kickstarter this month! 
29, the first chapter to No Longer Home, is now around 70% complete, and Kickstarter will help us give it a final push past the finish line. We'll be announcing the launch date here and on all other social media, so keep your eyes peeled!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30365921/c1982233a0a21335ee2df2f52aa88d503fe0653d.png
Secondly, alongside the launch of the Kickstarter, we are releasing a free game called Friary Road which acts as a short prequel to No Longer Home! Bo and Ao (protagonists of No Longer Home) are the only ones left after a barbecue and find themselves stargazing, pondering about their future, their identities, and what lies beyond their universe. The game is based off a very short vignette we made for the Fermi Paradox Jam on itch.io.

Friary Road is available immediately on Patreon for people who have pledged over $1 a month. If you’re not a patron, don’t worry! As we mentioned above, it will be available for everyone to play on the Kickstarter launch day. 

We’ll update you on an exact date for the Kickstarter and Friary Road soon!

-humble grove x

ps. We now have a twitter account for No Longer Home! Follow us here.
